name: Epic Battles of History
subtitle: Portrait 3v3 history brawler
localizedDescription: Historical figures brawl in a portrait 3v3 fighting game. This unsigned test build is for Feather on iOS 15.0 or later.

versions.localizedDescription:
New
- Pick your team before a match, and pick who you play in Training.
- Switch arenas from the arena picker.
- Luther fights with his own model, hammer and Door Service Special.
- Rate each match and flag a moment with a note; full matches are recorded for review.

Changed
- Team select moves on by itself once your team is set.
- A tagged-in fighter runs in along the floor.
- Input buffering and defence against Specials are reworked.
- The Flag button sits in the top-right corner.

Fixed
- The K.O. hand-off to the next fighter no longer pops.
- A black-screen bug from an earlier test build.

Known issues: This build has not been checked on a phone yet.

New
- Overload Grip has a visible overhand windup.

Changed
- Light hits, heavy hits and blocks use smaller contact effects.
- The knockout burst is smaller and the K.O.! banner sits above the fighters.

Fixed
- The orange grab warning clears when the windup ends or a Special interrupts it.
- Portrait Special shots leave more room for fighters to recoil.

Known issues: An ordinary throw can still crop a fighter during recovery.
